name: GNews
tagline: Real-time news search and headline API with worldwide coverage
description: GNews is a REST API that delivers news articles and top headlines from thousands of sources worldwide. Developers can search by keywords, topics, language, and country, and receive structured article metadata including title, description, content snippet, URL, image, published date, and source.

auth.details: API key via query parameter apikey=YOUR_API_KEY (self-serve signup on gnews.io)

pricing.paid_plans: Paid plans available with higher daily quotas; see pricing page for current tiers

rate_limits: Daily request quotas by plan (free: 100/day); additional per-second limits not clearly published
use_cases: search recent news articles by keyword
fetch top headlines for a country or topic
monitor brand or product mentions in news
build a news feed filtered by language
aggregate multi-source coverage on a breaking event
